questions.text:
Consider the following statements regarding the election of Harivansh Narayan Singh as the Deputy Chairman of the Rajya Sabha:
I. He has been elected to the post for the third consecutive time and was elected unopposed.
II. He is the first nominated member to assume the office of Deputy Chairman.
III. He was nominated to the House by President Droupadi Murmu following the retirement of Ranjan Gogoi.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is I, II, and III

In News

  • On April 17, 2026, Janata Dal (United) MP Harivansh Narayan Singh was elected as the Deputy Chairman of the Rajya Sabha for the third consecutive time.

Key Points

  • Statement I is correct: Harivansh was elected unopposed to the post of Deputy Chairman for his third consecutive term. The motion to choose him was moved by JP Nadda, the Leader of the House.
  • Statement II is correct: Leader of the Opposition, Mallikarjun Kharge, noted during his congratulatory speech that Harivansh is the first nominated member to assume the office of Deputy Chairman of the Rajya Sabha.
  • Statement III is correct: President Droupadi Murmu nominated Harivansh to the House to fill the vacancy created by the retirement of former Chief Justice of India Ranjan Gogoi.

Additional Information

  • The post of Deputy Chairman had fallen vacant after Harivansh's previous term ended on April 9th.
  • Prime Minister Narendra Modi lauded Harivansh's exemplary utilization of MPLADS funds and his contribution to the training of presiding officers of state legislative assemblies.
  • DMK MP Tiruchi Siva mentioned that if Harivansh completes this term, he would touch the record of Dr. Najma Heptulla, who held the post for four terms.

Important Points

  • The election reflects a spirit of consensus and cooperation as it was a unanimous election.
  • Harivansh emphasized that while healthy debate is integral to democracy, disruption has no place in parliamentary functioning.

questions.text: Which global e-commerce giant announced an investment of over $35 billion in India by 2030, focusing on AI-driven digitisation, export growth, and job creation, along with launching initiatives like “Accelerate Exports” and signing an MoU with Gati Shakti Vishwavidyalaya for education and skill development?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Amazon.

In News

  • Amazon announced plans to invest over $35 billion in India by 2030 across all its businesses, focusing on AI-driven digitisation, export growth, and job creation.

Key Points

  • The announcement was made at the 6th edition of the Amazon Smbhav Summit in New Delhi.
  • Amazon has already invested over $40 billion in India since 2013.
  • Introduced “Accelerate Exports”, a program connecting Indian entrepreneurs with manufacturers to sell globally.
  • Signed an MoU with Gati Shakti Vishwavidyalaya to collaborate on education, research, and skill development initiatives.
  • The investment aims to strengthen India’s AI, digital infrastructure, and export capabilities while creating employment.

Additional Information

  • Amazon – HQ Seattle, US | CEO – Andy Jassy | Incorporated – 1994
  • Microsoft Corp. – Committed $17.5 billion investment in India for data centres and AI infrastructure | HQ – Washington, US | CEO – Satya Nadella | Founded – 1975
  • Gati Shakti Vishwavidyalaya – Located in Vadodara, Gujarat | First Chancellor – Ashwini Vaishnaw
  • Focus Areas – AI-driven digitisation, export growth, job creation, and skill development.
  • Accelerate Exports Program – Supports Indian entrepreneurs and manufacturers in reaching global markets.

questions.text: The first BRICS Sherpa/Sous-Sherpa Meeting for India’s 2026 Chairship commenced on 9 February 2026 at which of the following places?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is New Delhi.

In News

  • The first BRICS Sherpa/Sous-Sherpa Meeting under India’s 2026 Chairship began on 9 February 2026 in New Delhi.

Key Points

  • The meeting marked the launch of India’s 2026 BRICS Chairmanship.
  • India is chairing BRICS for the fourth time (2012, 2016, 2021, and 2026).
  • The theme is “Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability”.
  • The priorities follow PM Narendra Modi’s “people-centric” and “humanity-first” vision.

Additional Information

  • Sherpas and Sous-Sherpas from 11 BRICS member countries participated in the meeting.
  • Belarus attended as a partner country for the first time at this level.

questions.text: An annual nationwide Mass Drug Administration (MDA) campaign for __________ elimination was recently launched across _______ endemic states/UTs.
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Lymphatic Filariasis; 12.

In News

  • Union Minister of State for Health and Family Welfare, Smt. Anupriya Patel, launched the first phase of the Annual Nationwide Mass Drug Administration (MDA) campaign for Lymphatic Filariasis elimination in February 2026.

Key Points

  • The campaign is being implemented across 12 endemic states and Union Territories (UTs) to achieve the goal of eliminating Lymphatic Filariasis (LF).
  • The target states/UTs include **Bihar, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, Karnataka, Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh, Odisha, Uttar Pradesh, West Bengal, Gujarat, and Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu.**
  • India has set a target to eliminate Lymphatic Filariasis by **2027**, which is three years ahead of the global target (2030).
  • Mass Drug Administration (MDA)
    • Strategy - Door-to-door delivery of anti-filarial drugs (DEC, Albendazole, and Ivermectin) to eligible populations.
    • Exclusions - Pregnant women, children below two years of age, and seriously ill persons are excluded from the drug administration.

Additional Information

  • Lymphatic Filariasis (LF)
    • Commonly known as Elephantiasis, it is a **Neglected Tropical Disease (NTD)** caused by parasitic worms and transmitted by mosquitoes.
    • It impairs the lymphatic system and can lead to abnormal enlargement of body parts, causing pain and severe disability.
  • Jan Bhagidari
    • The Minister emphasized a "Whole of Government" and "Whole of Society" approach to ensure every individual in endemic areas consumes the medicine in the presence of health workers.
  • Morbidity Management
    • Apart from drug administration, the government is also providing Morbidity Management and Disability Prevention (MMDP) services to those already affected by the disease.

questions.text: Which bank has recently (February 2026) launched an online portal to settle death claims up to Rs 15 lakh within 15 days?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Indian Overseas Bank.

In News

  • Indian Overseas Bank (IOB) has launched a new online portal that allows families and legal heirs to submit death claim settlement requests from anywhere, with claims up to Rs 15 lakh expected to be processed within 15 days.

Key Points

  • IOB’s online death claim portal simplifies the settlement process by allowing online filing and document uploads.
  • Claims up to Rs 15 lakh will be processed within 15 days under the bank’s new system. 
  • No third-party surety is required for claims up to Rs 15 lakh. 
  • The portal helps reduce paperwork and branch visits for claimants. 

Additional Information

  • Indian Overseas Bank (IOB) – A major public sector bank in India providing commercial and retail banking services nationwide.
  • Death Claim Settlement – The process where a bank pays the balance in the account of a deceased customer to the nominee or legal heirs after required documentation.
  • Online Portal – A digital platform enabling users to file and track applications and submit necessary documents virtually.
  • Processing Timeline – Under the new portal, the claim settlement process for amounts up to Rs 15 lakh is targeted to be completed within 15 days.

questions.text:
Consider the following statements regarding World Asthma Day:

I. It is observed every year on the first Tuesday of May.

II. It was started in 1998 by the World Health Organization (WHO).

III. The theme for 2026 is “Access to anti-inflammatory inhalers for everyone with asthma, still an urgent need.”

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Only I and III

In News

  • World Asthma Day will be observed on 5 May 2026, focusing on making anti-inflammatory inhalers accessible to everyone globally.

Key Points

  • Statement I is correct: World Asthma Day is observed every year on the first Tuesday of May across the world. In 2026, it falls on 5 May.
  • Statement II is incorrect: The day was started in 1998 by the Global Initiative for Asthma (GINA), not the World Health Organization (WHO), with the sole aim of improving asthma awareness and care globally.
  • Statement III is correct: The theme for 2026 is “Access to anti-inflammatory inhalers for everyone with asthma, still an urgent need.”

Additional Information

  • Asthma is a chronic condition that affects the airways, making it difficult to breathe.
  • Common asthma symptoms include shortness of breath, wheezing cough, tightness in the chest, and coughing at night.
  • Uneasiness or difficulty breathing after exercise and repeated cases of chest infections are also common triggers and symptoms for asthma patients.

Important Points

  • The 2026 theme emphasizes closing the global healthcare gap by ensuring access to essential medications regardless of a patient's geographic location or economic background.
  • GINA encourages governments and healthcare organizations to work collectively for better asthma management globally so that no one is denied necessary care.

questions.text: Union Home Minister Amit Shah launched ‘Bharat Taxi’, India’s first cooperative-based, zero-commission ride-hailing platform empowering driver-owners and offering surge-free fares. What are the drivers of the Bharat Taxi platform called?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Sarathis.

In News

  • Union Home and Cooperation Minister Shri Amit Shah launched India’s first cooperative-sector taxi service, “Bharat Taxi,” on February 5, 2026.

Key Points

  • Under the vision of ‘Sarathi Hi Malik’, the drivers on the Bharat Taxi platform are referred to as 'Sarathis' and are treated as owners in the cooperative.
  • Bharat Taxi is registered under the Multi-State Cooperative Societies Act, 2002, and operates on a zero-commission and surge-free pricing model.
  • Top-performing Sarathis were provided with share certificates along with personal accident insurance and family health insurance worth ₹5 lakh each.
  • To promote women’s empowerment and safety, the platform features the 'Sarathi Didi' and 'Bike Didi' initiatives.
  • Bharat Taxi Highlights:
    • Model: Cooperative-based, zero-commission, and surge-free.
    • Launch Date: 05 February 2026.
    • Driver Title: Sarathis.
    • Registration: Multi-State Cooperative Societies Act, 2002.

Additional Information

  • Sahkar se Samriddhi
    • The vision of Prime Minister Narendra Modi which aims to achieve prosperity through the cooperative movement.
  • Ministry of Cooperation
    • A newly formed ministry (in 2021) headed by Shri Amit Shah to provide a separate administrative, legal, and policy framework for strengthening the cooperative movement.
  • Sarathi Didi / Bike Didi
    • Specific sub-initiatives of Bharat Taxi aimed at increasing women's participation in the mobility sector and ensuring safe travel for women passengers.
  • Zero-Commission Model
    • Unlike private aggregators that charge 20-30% commission per ride, Bharat Taxi allows the full fare to go to the drivers, distributing profits directly to the cooperators.

questions.text: With which organisation has the National University of Singapore's Institute of Systems Science (NUS-ISS) signed an MoU to build AI governance and digital leadership capacity for Indian enterprises?

options.text: Federation of Indian Chambers of Commerce & Industry (FICCI)
National Association of Software and Service Companies (NASSCOM)
Associated Chambers of Commerce and Industry of India (ASSOCHAM)

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Confederation of Indian Industry (CII)

In News

  • The Confederation of Indian Industry (CII) and NUS-ISS of the National University of Singapore have signed a strategic Memorandum of Understanding (MoU).
  • The partnership aims to advance digital leadership and responsible AI governance among Indian enterprises through an exclusive executive certification programme.

Key Points

  • Joint Programme Delivery: Under the agreement, CII and NUS-ISS will jointly deliver the "Leadership Programme on Artificial Intelligence and Governance".
  • Target Audience: The capacity-building programme is tailored to equip board members, CXOs, and senior decision-makers with insights into AI, digital governance, innovation leadership, and cybersecurity.
  • Future Goals: The initiative formalises and expands upon pilot runs, planning half-yearly programmes in 2026, 2027, and 2028, with a target to train over 100 executives by the end of 2026.

Additional Information

  • Event Details: The MoU was exchanged at the CII Annual Business Summit 2026 in New Delhi.
  • Key Attendees: Exchanged in the presence of Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister N Chandrababu Naidu, Singapore High Commissioner to India Simon Wong, and CII President Rajiv Memani.
  • Anchoring Hub: The CII Global Leadership Centre located in Amaravati, Andhra Pradesh, will anchor these joint programmes on leadership and digitalisation.
  • Strategic Alignment: The initiative complements the 'Digitalisation' and 'Skilling' pillars under the Comprehensive Strategic Partnership between India and Singapore.

Important Points

  • Previous Success: The initiative builds on three successful pilot editions held in Singapore (Nov 2024, May 2025, Nov 2025), which trained more than 65 Indian industry executives.
  • About NUS-ISS: Established in 1981, the institute has trained over 210,000 digital leaders and professionals from more than 9,400 corporate organisations.

questions.text: Which Indian duo scripted history by becoming the first Indian men’s doubles pair to win the Singapore Open title in 2026?

options.text: Kim Won Ho and Seo Seung Jae
B. Sumeeth Reddy and Manu Attri

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty

In News

  • On May 31, 2026, Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty won the Singapore Open men's doubles title, ending a two-year title drought.

Key Points

  • Historical Achievement: The pair became the first Indian men's doubles team to win the Singapore Open event.
  • The Final Match: They defeated the Indonesian pair of Fajar Alfian and Muhammad Fikri with a score of 18-21, 21-17, 21-16 in a match that lasted one hour and 13 minutes.
  • Title Milestone: This victory marked their ninth career World Tour title and their third Super 750 crown.
  • Ending the Drought: Their last title before this win was at the Thailand Open in 2024; they had four runner-up finishes in the interim.

Additional Information

  • Rankings: The Indian duo entered the competition as the world No. 4 pair.
  • Tournament Highlights: En route to the final, they secured a significant semifinal victory against the reigning world champions, Kim Won Ho and Seo Seung Jae of South Korea.
  • Past Successes: Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty are also Asian Games and Commonwealth Games champions.

Important Points

  • Comparison with Options:
  • Srikanth Kidambi and Lakshya Sen: These are prominent Indian singles players and did not win the men's doubles title in this tournament.
  • Fajar Alfian and Muhammad Fikri: They were the finalists from Indonesia who were defeated by the Indian duo.
  • Kim Won Ho and Seo Seung Jae: They are the world champions from South Korea who were defeated by Satwik-Chirag in the semifinals.

questions.text: Who among the following set a new record for the highest individual score in an Under-19 Cricket World Cup final during the 2026 tournament in Harare, Zimbabwe?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Vaibhav Suryavanshi.

In News

  • India defeated England by 100 runs in the Under-19 Men's Cricket World Cup final held in Harare on February 6, 2026.

Key Points

  • Vaibhav Suryavanshi, aged 14, scored 175 runs off 80 balls, setting the record for the highest individual score ever made in an U19 Cricket World Cup final.
  • His innings included 30 boundaries (15 fours and 15 sixes) with a strike rate of 218.75, helping India reach a total of 411-9.
  • With this victory, India secured their sixth Under-19 World Cup title.
  • Suryavanshi surpassed the previous record for the highest score in a final, which was 111 runs set by Unmukt Chand in 2012.

Additional Information

  • Viran Chamuditha
    • Nationality - Sri Lanka
    • Achievement - Holds the record for the highest score in U19 World Cup history (overall, not just finals) with 192 runs against Japan in 2026.
  • Caleb Falconer
    • Nationality - England
    • Performance - Scored 115 off 67 balls in the 2026 final, making him the last man to fall in England's chase of 311.
  • Ayush Mhatre
    • Role - Captain of the India U19 team during the 2026 World Cup.
    • Performance - Scored 53 runs in the final, being the only other Indian batter to pass fifty.
  • Under-19 Cricket World Cup
    • Organising Body - International Cricket Council (ICC).
    • 2026 Venue - Zimbabwe (Harare).
    • Most Successful Team - India (6 Titles).
